project.name: recsys-api
project.description: A compact Maven workspace demonstrating recommendation-system serving, retrieval, ranking, and offline embedding pipelines across four independently runnable services.

nodes.name: RecommendationCacheProperties.java
nodes.summary: Spring Boot @ConfigurationProperties class binding the recsys.cache namespace; controls main recommendation cache TTL, size, cold-start cache settings, and compute-wait timeout.

nodes.name: RecommendationCacheProperties
nodes.summary: Configuration properties bean for the recommendation cache, exposing toggles for enable/disable, TTL, max entries, cold-start mode, and compute-wait timeout.

nodes.name: FeatureFlagProvider.java
nodes.summary: Functional interface defining the contract for resolving feature flag boolean values given a flag descriptor, distinct user ID, and evaluation properties.

nodes.name: FeatureFlagProvider
nodes.summary: Interface with a single resolve() method returning Optional<Boolean> for a given flag, user ID, and property map — the core abstraction for all feature-flag backends.

nodes.name: FeatureFlagService.java
nodes.summary: Spring service that wraps a FeatureFlagProvider and exposes convenience overloads of isEnabled(), falling back to the flag's default when the provider returns empty.

nodes.name: FeatureFlagService
nodes.summary: Service class delegating feature-flag resolution to a FeatureFlagProvider, offering three isEnabled() overloads with varying evaluation context granularity.

nodes.name: Flags.java
nodes.summary: Static constants class declaring the application's named feature flags (COLD_START_ENABLED, NEW_RANKING) as FeatureFlag instances.

nodes.name: FeatureFlagConfig.java
nodes.summary: Spring @Configuration class that wires up the feature-flag provider chain: always includes EnvFeatureFlagProvider, optionally wraps a PostHog provider with CachingFeatureFlagProvider, and composes them in a CompositeFeatureFlagProvider.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a nested PostHogProperties inner class with a cacheTtl field validated on set to reject zero/negative durations.

nodes.name: FeatureFlagConfig
nodes.summary: Spring @Configuration that creates the FeatureFlagProvider and FeatureFlagService beans, composing environment-variable and optional PostHog providers.

nodes.name: FeatureFlag.java
nodes.summary: Immutable record or class representing a named feature flag with its key and default enabled state, providing factory methods disabledByDefault() and enabledByDefault().

nodes.name: CachingFeatureFlagProvider.java
nodes.summary: Decorator FeatureFlagProvider that caches resolved flag values (including empty results) in a nanosecond-precision TTL cache to reduce calls to a delegate provider.

nodes.name: CachingFeatureFlagProvider
nodes.summary: FeatureFlagProvider decorator that implements a simple TTL cache keyed on (flagKey, distinctId), with evictExpired() for manual cache purging.

nodes.name: CompositeFeatureFlagProvider.java
nodes.summary: Chain-of-responsibility FeatureFlagProvider that iterates an ordered list of providers and returns the first non-empty resolution, falling back to Optional.empty().

nodes.name: CompositeFeatureFlagProvider
nodes.summary: Composite pattern implementation of FeatureFlagProvider that stops at the first provider that can resolve the flag.

nodes.name: EnvFeatureFlagProvider.java
nodes.summary: FeatureFlagProvider that reads boolean flag values from environment variables, normalizing camelCase flag keys to UPPER_SNAKE_CASE with a configurable prefix.

nodes.name: EnvFeatureFlagProvider
nodes.summary: Reads feature flags from environment variables by translating flag keys to upper-snake-case and optionally prepending a prefix.

nodes.name: PostHogFeatureFlagProvider.java
nodes.summary: FeatureFlagProvider that calls the PostHog /decide API over HTTP to evaluate feature flags, sending user identity and evaluation properties as JSON.

nodes.name: PostHogFeatureFlagProvider
nodes.summary: Makes synchronous HTTP POST requests to PostHog's decide endpoint, parses the JSON featureFlags map, and resolves boolean flags (non-null string values treated as enabled).

nodes.name: RecommendationConverter.java
nodes.summary: Utility class that converts raw recommendation results into RecommendResponse objects and normalizes exclude-item-ID lists for deduplication.

nodes.name: RecommendationConverter
nodes.summary: Stateless converter providing toResponse() to build a RecommendResponse and normalizedExcludeItemIds() to produce a deduplicated, sorted exclusion list.

nodes.name: ScoredItem.java
nodes.summary: Record or value type holding an item ID and its recommendation score, used throughout the model-serving pipeline.

nodes.name: RecommendRequest.java
nodes.summary: Jackson-serializable request DTO carrying userId, k (number of recommendations), and an optional list of item IDs to exclude from results.

nodes.name: RecommendRequest
nodes.summary: Spring MVC request body DTO with userId, k, and excludeItemIds fields; setExcludeItemIds defensively copies the input list.

nodes.name: RecommendResponse.java
nodes.summary: Immutable response record/class wrapping userId, modelVersion, variant assignment, and the ranked list of ScoredItem recommendations.

nodes.name: ABTestService.java
nodes.summary: Service that assigns users to A/B test variants by hashing userId+layerName mod trafficSplitNumber, delegating to ABTestConfig for bucket-to-variant mappings.

nodes.name: ABTestService
nodes.summary: Deterministic A/B assignment service using hash-based bucket resolution; supports per-layer experiments and exposes both variant string and full Assignment record.

nodes.name: FeatureEncoder.java
nodes.summary: Encodes a RecommendRequest into ONNX-ready integer feature indices using user and item vocabulary maps from the model artifact service.

nodes.name: FeatureEncoder
nodes.summary: Converts user IDs to vocab indices (defaulting to UNK) and item IDs to embedding indices for ONNX model input construction.

nodes.name: RecommendationCache.java
nodes.summary: Two-tier in-process LRU+TTL cache for recommendation results and cold-start pools, with read-write locking, stampede prevention via CompletableFuture in-flight tracking, and hit-rate statistics.
nodes.languageNotes: Inner TtlLruCache extends LinkedHashMap for LRU eviction and uses ReentrantReadWriteLock + ConcurrentHashMap of CompletableFutures to prevent cache stampedes.

nodes.name: RecommendationCache
nodes.summary: Main recommendation cache managing two TtlLruCache instances (recommendations and cold starts), with getOrCompute() blocking until computation completes under concurrent access.

nodes.name: RecommendationService.java
nodes.summary: Core model-based recommendation service orchestrating A/B test assignment, cache lookup, cold-start fallback via feature flags, and full two-tower ONNX inference pipeline.

nodes.name: RecommendationService
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full recommendation flow: validates input, determines A/B variant, serves from cache when possible, falls back to cold-start pool for unknown users (gated by feature flag), and computes fresh recommendations via ONNX runtime.

nodes.name: recommend
nodes.summary: Validates the request, resolves the A/B assignment, and dispatches to the cache-then-compute path returning a fully populated RecommendResponse.

nodes.name: ScoredItems.java
nodes.summary: Utility class with static helpers for maintaining a min-heap of top-K ScoredItem results and sorting them in descending score order.

nodes.name: UserTowerInferenceService.java
nodes.summary: ONNX Runtime inference service for the user-tower model, supporting single-item scoring, batch scoring, and top-K candidate scoring from a pre-encoded feature vector.

nodes.name: UserTowerInferenceService
nodes.summary: Wraps an OnnxRuntime OrtSession for the user-tower model; init() loads model bytes via ArtifactLocator, and scoreCandidates() runs batched inference over candidate item IDs returning top-K ScoredItems.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses OnnxRuntime Java API with LongBuffer tensors; requires -Xshare:off JVM flag due to ONNX library constraints.

nodes.name: FeatureFlagServiceTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests for FeatureFlagService verifying that provider-resolved values override defaults, empty provider responses fall back to flag defaults, and evaluation context is correctly forwarded.

nodes.name: FeatureFlagConfigTest.java
nodes.summary: Spring Boot ApplicationContextRunner tests for FeatureFlagConfig, verifying bean creation, property binding, PostHog provider wrapping in CachingFeatureFlagProvider, and cache TTL binding.

nodes.name: CachingFeatureFlagProviderTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests for CachingFeatureFlagProvider covering cache hits, TTL expiry triggering delegate re-calls, per-user isolation, empty-result caching, evictExpired(), and validation of zero/negative TTL arguments.

nodes.name: CompositeFeatureFlagProviderTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit test for CompositeFeatureFlagProvider ensuring the first resolved value (including false) is returned and subsequent providers are not consulted.

nodes.name: EnvFeatureFlagProviderTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests for EnvFeatureFlagProvider covering camelCase-to-upper-snake-case normalization, true/false value parsing, and missing/invalid env var handling.

nodes.name: PostHogFeatureFlagProviderTest.java
nodes.summary: Integration-style unit tests for PostHogFeatureFlagProvider using a stub HTTP client to verify request construction, boolean flag resolution, multivariate flag handling, and HTTP failure fallback.

nodes.name: FeatureEncoderTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests for FeatureEncoder verifying known-user index lookup, unknown-user UNK fallback, and UNK token zero-index behavior using a Mockito-mocked ArtifactService.

nodes.name: InferenceLoadTest.java
nodes.summary: Load test measuring concurrent recommendation throughput and P95 latency using a real ModelRuntimeProvider, verifying ≥95% success rate and P95 ≤ threshold.

nodes.name: PredictionIntegrationTest.java
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the full recommendation pipeline (real ONNX model), verifying known/unknown user responses, k-limit enforcement, score ordering, and exclude-item filtering.

nodes.name: RankingServiceTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests for RankingService covering inner-product descending order, top-K truncation, missing embedding skipping, null user embedding, empty recall, zero k, and duplicate item deduplication.

nodes.name: RecommendationCacheTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests for RecommendationCache verifying basic cache get/put, TTL expiry, cold-start path, and cache-disabled passthrough behavior.

nodes.name: RecommendationServiceTest.java
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit tests for RecommendationService using Mockito mocks, covering A/B variant routing, cache hit/miss paths, cold-start feature-flag gating, and input validation.

nodes.name: RetrievalServiceTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests for RetrievalService (candidate recall) verifying that top-K nearest neighbors are returned in order and edge cases such as empty recall are handled.

nodes.name: Movie.java
nodes.summary: Domain record defining the Movie entity with id, title, year, and genre list used throughout the recommendation system.

nodes.name: PredictInstance.java
nodes.summary: Domain DTO representing a user-movie pair instance used as input to the pair-based prediction service.

nodes.name: PredictInstance
nodes.summary: Simple POJO holding userId and movieId fields for embedding-based pair prediction input.

nodes.name: Rating.java
nodes.summary: Domain record representing a user rating event with userId, movieId, rating score, and timestamp.

nodes.name: User.java
nodes.summary: Domain record representing a system user with minimal identity fields.

nodes.name: DataLoader.java
nodes.summary: Loads movies, users, ratings, and embeddings from classpath text files and builds derived data structures such as similar-movie co-rating maps and genre indexes.

nodes.name: DataLoader
nodes.summary: Utility class that parses flat files for movies, users, ratings, and Word2Vec embeddings, constructing co-rating-based similarity maps and sorted genre/rating indexes.

nodes.name: buildSimilarMovies
nodes.summary: Computes co-rating counts between movie pairs across users and returns a top-K similar-movie map per movie using a priority queue.

nodes.name: loadEmbeddings
nodes.summary: Parses an embedding file from classpath resources, delegating vector parsing to VectorMath and returning an immutable id-to-float-array map.

nodes.name: DataManager.java
nodes.summary: Singleton data access facade that eagerly loads all dataset artifacts via DataLoader on construction and exposes query methods for movies, users, ratings, and similarity lookups.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the singleton pattern via a static INSTANCE field initialized in a static initializer block; not thread-safe for lazy initialization but acceptable since loading happens once at JVM startup.

nodes.name: DataManager
nodes.summary: Singleton wrapping all in-memory dataset indexes, delegating loading to DataLoader and providing query methods for movies, users, ratings, and genre/similarity lookups.

nodes.name: PairPredictionService.java
nodes.summary: Computes inner-product similarity scores for user-movie embedding pairs using pre-loaded float-array embeddings.

nodes.name: PairPredictionService
nodes.summary: Service that takes a list of PredictInstance objects and computes dot-product scores between user and movie embeddings, validating inputs strictly.

nodes.name: predict
nodes.summary: Iterates PredictInstance list, retrieves user/movie embeddings, computes inner product scores, and returns a parallel list of score lists.

nodes.name: RedisTopKStore.java
nodes.summary: Redis-backed implementation of TrendingStore that fetches top-K item IDs from sorted sets with in-memory hot-key caching and in-flight deduplication.

nodes.name: RedisTopKStore
nodes.summary: Implements TrendingStore by reading Redis sorted sets per time window with an in-process ConcurrentHashMap cache to avoid hot-key stampedes.

nodes.name: getTopKIds
nodes.summary: Returns top-K item IDs for a time window; serves from local cache when fresh, otherwise delegates to fetchWindow with inflight deduplication.

nodes.name: ShardedTopKStore.java
nodes.summary: Sharded Redis top-K store that distributes trending data across N shards for hot-key mitigation, with local in-process caching, HotKeyDetector integration, and legacy single-key fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses multiple constructors for flexible shard configuration and integrates HotKeyDetector to adaptively route hot keys to different shards.

nodes.name: ShardedTopKStore
nodes.summary: TrendingStore implementation that shards Redis sorted-set keys across configurable shard count, reads from a random shard, seeds all shards from a legacy key, and tracks hit metrics.

nodes.name: getTopKIds
nodes.summary: Serves top-K trending IDs from a local cache or a randomly chosen shard, falling back to legacy single-key if shards are unavailable.

nodes.name: CandidateGenerator.java
nodes.summary: Generates recommendation candidates via three strategies: genre-based, user-history-based, and embedding nearest-neighbor recall, backed by an in-memory ExactVectorIndex over Word2Vec embeddings.

nodes.name: CandidateGenerator
nodes.summary: Core candidate retrieval class combining genre filtering, watched-movie history, and cosine-similarity embedding recall using an ExactVectorIndex built from DataLoader embeddings.

nodes.name: byEmbedding
nodes.summary: Returns top-K movie candidates by cosine similarity to a given embedding vector, excluding already-watched movies.

nodes.name: ExactVectorIndex.java
nodes.summary: Thread-safe in-memory brute-force vector similarity index supporting add/update of float-array embeddings and top-K nearest-neighbor search by cosine similarity.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a ReentrantReadWriteLock for concurrent read access, making it suitable for high-throughput serving scenarios with infrequent writes.

nodes.name: ExactVectorIndex
nodes.summary: Maintains a read-write-locked map of id-to-embedding and scans all entries for top-K cosine similarity lookup.

nodes.name: CandidateSelectionService.java
nodes.summary: Selects a ranked candidate set from the in-memory dataset for model-based scoring, merging top-rated, genre-matched, and similar-movie candidates.

nodes.name: CandidateSelectionService
nodes.summary: Assembles a candidate pool for a given user by drawing from top-rated movies, genre-based lists, and similar-movie neighbors via DataManager.

nodes.name: RetrievalService.java
nodes.summary: Spring component that encodes user embeddings for the two-tower ONNX model path and performs embedding-based plus metadata-based recall, returning merged ScoredItem candidates.

nodes.name: RetrievalService
nodes.summary: Spring @Service wrapping embedding-based and metadata-based candidate retrieval, merging results by best cosine score for the model-based recommendation path.

nodes.name: recall
nodes.summary: Orchestrates embedding recall and metadata recall for a given user, filters watched movies, and merges candidates by best score.

nodes.name: ExperienceCollector.java
nodes.summary: Collects and serializes online serving experiences (impressions, clicks) into JSON training examples by joining with recommendation context via OnlineJoiner.

nodes.name: ExperienceCollector
nodes.summary: Collects impression and feedback events from online serving, joins them via OnlineJoiner, and produces JSON experience records for downstream online learning.

nodes.name: collect
nodes.summary: Records a serving event (impression or feedback signal) and delegates to OnlineJoiner to join with recommendation context, returning a joined Experience.

nodes.name: OnlineLearner.java
nodes.summary: Implements lightweight online learning by updating per-item bias parameters from experience events using logistic loss, with Redis persistence and in-memory eviction.

nodes.name: OnlineLearner
nodes.summary: Maintains a ConcurrentHashMap of item bias parameters updated via logistic regression on experience signals, supports Redis-backed persistence and LRU-style eviction.

nodes.name: learn
nodes.summary: Processes a single experience to update item bias scores using gradient descent on logistic loss, optionally flushing to Redis.

nodes.name: flushToRedis
nodes.summary: Serializes current item biases as a Redis hash, enabling cross-instance parameter sharing in multi-node deployments.

nodes.name: OnlineRecommendationEngine.java
nodes.summary: Core online recommendation logic that blends recent-history-based and trending-based scores to produce a ranked list of movie candidates.

nodes.name: OnlineRecommendationEngine
nodes.summary: Stateless recommendation engine that scores movies by combining recent user history signal from RecentHistoryStore with global trending signal from TrendingStore.

nodes.name: recommend
nodes.summary: Fetches recent history and trending candidates, blends their scores, excludes watched movies, and returns top-N ranked results.

nodes.name: OnlineRecommendationResult.java
nodes.summary: Immutable DTO wrapping the result of an online recommendation request, holding the requesting user and the list of recommended movies.

nodes.name: OnlineRecommendationService.java
nodes.summary: Orchestrates online recommendation by blending engine-based candidates with embedding-recall candidates and applying learned item biases from OnlineLearner.

nodes.name: OnlineRecommendationService
nodes.summary: Blends online (history+trending) recommendation signals with embedding-based candidates and applies OnlineLearner bias adjustments to produce a final ranked list.

nodes.name: recommend
nodes.summary: Entry point that validates user, fetches online and embedding candidates, calls blend, and returns an OnlineRecommendationResult.

nodes.name: blend
nodes.summary: Merges online and embedding candidate lists by deduplicated score, applies learned item biases, and limits to the requested top-N.

nodes.name: RecentHistoryStore.java
nodes.summary: Interface defining the contract for retrieving a user's recent movie interaction history.

nodes.name: TrendingStore.java
nodes.summary: Interface defining the contract for retrieving the top-K trending item IDs for a given time window.

nodes.name: EmbeddingChannel.java
nodes.summary: Retrieval channel that generates movie candidates by nearest-neighbor embedding lookup for a given recommendation query.

nodes.name: EmbeddingChannel
nodes.summary: Implements a recall channel that invokes CandidateGenerator.byEmbedding for the user's embedding vector, returning MovieCandidate results.

nodes.name: GenreHistoryChannel.java
nodes.summary: Retrieval channel that generates movie candidates based on the user's genre preferences derived from rating history.

nodes.name: GenreHistoryChannel
nodes.summary: Implements a recall channel using CandidateGenerator.byGenre to surface movies from genres the user has historically rated.

nodes.name: PopularityChannel.java
nodes.summary: Retrieval channel that surfaces globally popular movies from DataManager as fallback or diversity candidates.

nodes.name: PopularityChannel
nodes.summary: Implements a recall channel using DataManager.getTopRatedMovies to provide popularity-based candidates.

nodes.name: MovieService.java
nodes.summary: Jetty servlet handler for the /movie endpoint, returning a single Movie by ID as JSON.

nodes.name: MovieService
nodes.summary: HttpServlet subclass that processes GET requests by looking up a Movie from DataManager and responding with JSON.

nodes.name: RecSysServer.java
nodes.summary: Entry point for the offline RecSys Jetty server; wires all servlet handlers, initializes Redis connections, embedding stores, candidate generators, and multi-channel recall service.

nodes.name: RecSysServer
nodes.summary: Bootstraps a Jetty server on a configurable port, registers all servlet endpoints, seeds Redis embeddings if empty, and wires the multi-channel recall service.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: JVM entry point that instantiates and starts RecSysServer.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Configures and starts the Jetty server, registers all servlet routes, and seeds embedding stores.

nodes.name: SimilarMovieService.java
nodes.summary: Jetty servlet handler for the /similar endpoint, performing embedding-based similar-movie lookup via ExactVectorIndex with a DataManager fallback.

nodes.name: SimilarMovieService
nodes.summary: Servlet that finds movies similar to a given movie using ExactVectorIndex for embedding similarity, falling back to DataManager co-rating similarity when no embedding is available.

nodes.name: UserService.java
nodes.summary: Jetty servlet handler for the /user endpoint, returning a User by ID as JSON.

nodes.name: UserService
nodes.summary: HttpServlet subclass that processes GET requests by looking up a User from DataManager and responding with JSON.

nodes.name: OnlineLearnerTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests for OnlineLearner verifying that positive and negative experience signals correctly adjust item biases and that learnAll snapshots are immutable.

nodes.name: OnlineRecommendationEngineTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests for OnlineRecommendationEngine verifying that history and trending signals are correctly blended and watched movies are excluded from results.

nodes.name: OnlineRecommendationServiceTest.java
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit tests for OnlineRecommendationService covering blending, fallback behavior, recall headroom, exclusion of watched movies, and impact of learned parameters.

nodes.name: EmbeddingChannelTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests for EmbeddingChannel verifying candidate recall for known users, empty results for unknown users, and correct channel name.

nodes.name: GenreHistoryChannelTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests for GenreHistoryChannel verifying genre-based candidate recall and empty results for users with no rating history.

nodes.name: RecSysServerIntegrationTest.java
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the full RecSysServer Jetty stack, covering all HTTP endpoints including movie lookup, user lookup, recommendations, similar movies, predict, and embedding set.

nodes.name: ConsistentHashRing.java
nodes.summary: Implements a consistent hash ring using FNV1a hashing with configurable virtual nodes to distribute device IDs across Redis shards evenly.

nodes.name: ConsistentHashRing
nodes.summary: Consistent hash ring that maps device IDs to shard indices using a TreeMap-based ring with virtual nodes to minimize rebalancing.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses TreeMap.ceilingEntry with ring wrap-around for O(log n) shard lookup.

nodes.name: Page.java
nodes.summary: Generic paginated result record holding a list of records, a cursor for the next page, and a hasMore flag for the sharded record store.

nodes.name: RecordType.java
nodes.summary: Enum defining the types of records stored in the sharded Redis record store (e.g. VIEW, CLICK).

nodes.name: SequenceGenerator.java
nodes.summary: Redis-backed monotonic sequence generator per shard that initializes counters by scanning existing records, ensuring unique sequence numbers for sharded writes.

nodes.name: SequenceGenerator
nodes.summary: Generates monotonically increasing sequence numbers stored as Redis counters, with initialization by scanning existing sorted set scores.

nodes.name: ShardCursor.java
nodes.summary: Immutable cursor record for paginated reads across sharded Redis streams, encoding a string position value with start-position detection.

nodes.name: ShardedRecord.java
nodes.summary: Immutable record type representing a single event stored in the sharded Redis record store, carrying device ID, event ID, type, payload, sequence number, and timestamp.

nodes.name: ShardedRecordStore.java
nodes.summary: Core Redis-backed sharded record store that writes events as hash entries with sorted set and stream indices, supporting per-device and per-shard paginated reads.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Redis pipelining for atomic multi-structure writes (hash + sorted set + stream) and ZAddParams for conditional updates.

nodes.name: ShardedRecordStore
nodes.summary: Provides write and paginated read operations over a sharded Redis namespace, using a ConsistentHashRing for shard routing and a SequenceGenerator for ordering.

nodes.name: WriteResult.java
nodes.summary: Immutable result record returned from a sharded record store write, carrying the assigned shard index, sequence number, and WriteStatus.

nodes.name: WriteStatus.java
nodes.summary: Enum representing the outcome of a sharded record store write operation (e.g. WRITTEN, UPDATED).

nodes.name: GatewayHealthService.java
nodes.summary: Armeria HTTP service for the API gateway's /health endpoint that concurrently pings all registered backend routes and returns an aggregated health status including circuit-breaker state.

nodes.name: GatewayHealthService
nodes.summary: Handles GET /health by fanning out HTTP health probes to each route concurrently and merging results with circuit-breaker state.

nodes.name: AsyncEventPublisher.java
nodes.summary: Non-blocking event publisher that buffers events in a bounded queue and drains them in batches on a background daemon thread, with drop-counting on overflow.

nodes.name: AsyncEventPublisher
nodes.summary: Thread-safe async event queue that supports configurable batch sizes and queue capacities, exposing a snapshot for metrics and a close() for graceful shutdown.

nodes.name: LearnerFlushScheduler.java
nodes.summary: Schedules periodic flushes of the online learner's item biases to Redis on a configurable interval, tracking flush counts and errors for observability.

nodes.name: LearnerFlushScheduler
nodes.summary: Wraps a ScheduledExecutorService to call OnlineLearner.flushToRedis at fixed intervals and flushes remaining state on close.

nodes.name: OnlineAdmissionControl.java
nodes.summary: Armeria SimpleDecoratingHttpService that gates requests through a load shedder and records rejections, wrapping downstream handlers to release the semaphore after response completion.

nodes.name: OnlineAdmissionControl
nodes.summary: Decorator that calls OnlineLoadShedder.tryAcquire before forwarding a request, returns 429 on shed, and releases the slot once the response completes.

nodes.name: OnlineCapacityService.java
nodes.summary: Provides capacity planning data (target DAU, peak QPS, peak TPS) and produces a capacity snapshot relative to observed load and utilization.

nodes.name: OnlineHealthService.java
nodes.summary: Armeria HTTP service for the online server's /health endpoint that reports QPS, in-flight requests, and load-shedding state as a JSON response.

nodes.name: OnlineLoadShedder.java
nodes.summary: Semaphore-based load shedder that limits concurrent in-flight requests and calculates utilization, drain thresholds, and retry-after guidance for overload responses.

nodes.name: OnlineLoadShedder
nodes.summary: Thread-safe in-flight counter with configurable max concurrency and drain utilization threshold, returning accept/reject decisions via tryAcquire and releasing on completion.

nodes.name: OnlineOpsService.java
nodes.summary: Armeria HTTP service exposing a /online/ops endpoint that returns a JSON operations snapshot including metrics, load shedder state, capacity, rate limiter status, and event publisher queue stats.

nodes.name: OnlineOpsService
nodes.summary: Aggregates snapshots from all ops components (metrics, load shedder, capacity, Redis rate limiter, event publisher) and serializes them as a JSON response.

nodes.name: OnlineServingMetricsService.java
nodes.summary: Thread-safe sliding-window metrics tracker for the online serving layer, tracking QPS, failure rates, latency percentiles (P50/P95/P99), rejected requests, and per-strategy breakdowns with Micrometer gauge registration.

nodes.name: OnlineServingMetricsService
nodes.summary: Maintains a sliding-window deque of request records plus a reservoir sample for percentile estimation; exposes snapshot(), scrapeSnapshot() for Micrometer, and registerGauges() for Prometheus export.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses reservoir sampling (Vitter's Algorithm R pattern) for P50/P95/P99 estimation without external dependencies.

nodes.name: RedisRateLimiter.java
nodes.summary: Redis Lua script-based sliding-window rate limiter with local pass-through fraction, circuit breaker fallback on Redis errors, and a disabled() factory for testing.

nodes.name: RedisRateLimiter
nodes.summary: Executes a Lua EVALSHA for atomic sliding-window rate counting; falls back to allow-all when the Redis circuit opens after consecutive failures, and supports a local pre-filter to reduce Redis load.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses jedis.eval with a stored Lua script to atomically increment and expire the rate-limit counter in a single round-trip.

nodes.name: ApiService.java
nodes.summary: Marker interface that extends BaseApiService for all online serving HTTP handlers, establishing a common base type for the online prediction subsystem.

nodes.name: OnlineFeaturesService.java
nodes.summary: Armeria HTTP handler for /online/features that applies load shedding and rate limiting before invoking the recommendation service and publishing a feature-view event asynchronously.

nodes.name: OnlineFeaturesService
nodes.summary: HTTP GET handler that gates through OnlineLoadShedder and RedisRateLimiter, calls the recommendation service, serializes the result, and asynchronously publishes a view event via AsyncEventPublisher.

nodes.name: OnlinePredictionServer.java
nodes.summary: Entry point for the Online Serving microservice that wires all dependencies (Redis pools, feature stores, learner, metrics, load shedding, rate limiting) and starts an Armeria HTTP server on the configured port.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the entire online serving stack: creates Redis connections, initializes all infrastructure objects, registers Prometheus metrics, and starts the Armeria server with graceful shutdown.

nodes.name: OnlinePredictionService.java
nodes.summary: Armeria HTTP handler for /online/recommendation that applies load shedding and rate limiting before calling the recommendation service and returning a ranked movie list.

nodes.name: OnlinePredictionService
nodes.summary: HTTP GET handler for recommendation requests that enforces concurrency and rate limits, records strategy-tagged metrics, and returns trending plus recently-watched movie IDs.

nodes.name: OnlineFeatureStore.java
nodes.summary: Redis-backed feature store with a two-level stale-while-revalidate in-process cache for user feature vectors, supporting batched mget fetches and TTL-based eviction.

nodes.name: OnlineFeatureStore
nodes.summary: Maintains a ConcurrentHashMap cache with fresh/stale TTL semantics; uses in-flight deduplication (CompletableFuture per key) to avoid thundering-herd on Redis for hot keys.
nodes.languageNotes: Stale-while-revalidate pattern: serves stale values while an async Redis fetch completes, using an inflight map to coalesce concurrent lookups.

nodes.name: ShardedRecordService.java
nodes.summary: Armeria HTTP handler bridging REST calls to the ShardedRecordStore, exposing write (POST), per-device read, and per-shard read endpoints under the /shards/ path prefix.

nodes.name: ShardedRecordService
nodes.summary: Delegates write/read operations to ShardedRecordStore and serializes results to JSON, parsing ShardedRecord fields from request body and query parameters.

nodes.name: BaseApiService.java
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for all Armeria HTTP service handlers, providing shared utilities for JSON serialization, error response formatting with Retry-After headers, and query parameter parsing.

nodes.name: BaseApiService
nodes.summary: Provides writeJson, writeError, writeErrorWithRetryAfter, readJsonBody, requiredIntParam, optionalIntParam, and optionalLongParam for use by all HTTP handler subclasses.

nodes.name: OnlinePredictionLoadTest.java
nodes.summary: JUnit load tests for the online prediction server verifying steady-state 200 RPS throughput and burst-overload load-shedding behavior using a mock recommendation engine.

nodes.name: OnlinePredictionServerIntegrationTest.java
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the OnlinePredictionServer wiring the full stack with in-memory mocks and a mock Redis, verifying recommendation, load-shedding, and health endpoints.

nodes.name: SubmitTokenProperties.java

nodes.name: RedisConnectionFactory
nodes.summary: Static factory class providing `from`, `fromEnv`, `routerFrom`, and `routerFromEnv` methods for constructing Jedis pools and read-replica routers, including sentinel and standalone modes with configurable pool sizes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses GenericObjectPoolConfig<Jedis> for type-safe pool configuration and supports both RedisProperties bean injection and environment-variable-based construction for non-Spring contexts.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Creates a JedisPool or JedisSentinelPool from a RedisProperties bean, selecting standalone vs. sentinel mode and configuring pool and client settings.

nodes.name: routerFrom

nodes.name: RedisReadReplicaRouter.java
nodes.summary: Routes Redis read operations to AZ-local replica pools when available, falling back to random replica selection or primary, and wraps multiple JedisPools for coordinated lifecycle close.

nodes.name: RedisReadReplicaRouter
nodes.summary: Holds a primary JedisPool and a list of AZ-tagged replica pools, providing `writablePool()` and `readablePool()` methods that implement AZ-aware replica selection with random fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ThreadLocalRandom for lock-free replica pool selection and stores replicas as AzPool records containing pool and AZ label.

nodes.name: readablePool
nodes.summary: Selects the best JedisPool for reads by preferring a replica in the local AZ, falling back to a random replica, or returning the primary pool when no replicas exist.

nodes.name: LoginController

nodes.name: login
nodes.summary: Validates the provided API key against configured keys using constant-time comparison and creates a session token on success, throwing UnauthorizedException on failure.

nodes.summary: Handles POST recommendation requests with multi-layer protection: rate limit check, submit-token validation, A/B assignment, load shedder with cache fallback, inference, and metrics recording.

nodes.name: VersionController

nodes.name: ApiError.java

nodes.name: ApiResponseUtil.java

nodes.name: ServiceOverloadedException.java
nodes.summary: Runtime exception thrown when the load shedder determines the service is overloaded, carrying a retry-after hint in seconds used by GlobalExceptionHandler to return a 503 with Retry-After.

nodes.name: SubmitTokenException.java
nodes.summary: Custom unchecked exception thrown when a CSRF submit-token is missing, expired, or already consumed, mapped to HTTP 409 by the global exception handler.

nodes.name: UnauthorizedException.java
nodes.summary: Custom unchecked exception thrown when a login token is blank or not found in Redis, mapped to HTTP 401 by the global exception handler.

nodes.name: LoginRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying a single apiKey field for the login endpoint, annotated with Bean Validation constraints.

nodes.name: ModelVersionRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO used by the version management endpoints to specify a target model variant name.

nodes.name: LoginResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO returned by the login endpoint, carrying the generated session token.

nodes.name: ModelVersionResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO returned by the model-version management endpoints, containing a list of loaded variant-version entries including ready status and active flag.

nodes.name: SubmitTokenResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO returned by the submit-token endpoint, carrying the token value and its TTL in seconds.

nodes.name: GcEventTracker.java
nodes.summary: Registers JVM GarbageCollector MXBean notification listeners to track GC events by type (minor/major/full/concurrent), recording STW pause histograms, allocation bytes, promotion bytes, evacuation failures, and allocation stalls.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses LongAdder arrays for lock-free concurrent metric accumulation across GC event types.

nodes.name: GcEventTracker
nodes.summary: Spring component that installs GarbageCollector notification listeners at startup, classifies each GC event, and exposes an aggregated Snapshot for health endpoint reporting.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: Iterates all GarbageCollectorMXBean instances and registers this tracker as a notification listener on each.

nodes.name: onNotification
nodes.summary: JMX notification handler that receives each GC notification, extracts GcInfo, classifies the event type, and delegates to recordStwPause, recordMemoryDeltas, and recordDangerSignals.

nodes.name: classifyEvent
nodes.summary: Heuristically maps a GC event's action/name/cause strings to a GcType enum (MINOR, MAJOR, FULL, CONCURRENT) by substring matching against known collector names.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Builds and returns an immutable Snapshot record containing per-type GC counts, pause histograms, and allocation/promotion/danger-signal totals.

nodes.name: InferenceMetricsService.java
nodes.summary: Records per-request inference latency and success/failure outcomes in a sliding time-window, exposes rolling failure rate and throughput metrics via Micrometer, and provides per-variant A/B test snapshots.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a lock-guarded ArrayDeque window to evict old RequestRecord entries and compute rolling aggregates without external time-series storage.

nodes.name: InferenceMetricsService
nodes.summary: Spring service that tracks inference request outcomes, latency, and per-variant A/B metrics using atomic counters and a configurable rolling window.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Computes and returns an immutable Snapshot of the current rolling-window metrics including failure rate, average latency, and throughput.

nodes.name: abTestSnapshot
nodes.summary: Returns an ABTestSnapshot comparing each tracked variant's success rate and average latency against the designated control variant.

nodes.name: JvmMemoryMonitor.java
nodes.summary: Provides a point-in-time JVM memory snapshot by reading MemoryMXBean, MemoryPoolMXBean, GarbageCollectorMXBean, and ThreadMXBean, classifying collectors by GC algorithm.

nodes.name: JvmMemoryMonitor
nodes.summary: Spring component exposing a snapshot() method that collects heap/non-heap pool stats, thread counts, and GC collector stats for health reporting.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Queries all JVM management beans and assembles a comprehensive Snapshot record with per-pool and per-collector stats.

nodes.name: LoadShedder.java
nodes.summary: Enforces a concurrency-based load-shedding policy using a Semaphore to cap in-flight requests, tracking accepted/rejected counters via Micrometer and exposing a utilization ratio for readiness checks.

nodes.name: LoadShedder
nodes.summary: Spring service implementing semaphore-based request throttling with Micrometer gauges for in-flight count and utilization ratio.

nodes.name: tryAcquire
nodes.summary: Attempts to acquire a semaphore slot for a new request; rejects if shutting down or no slot is available, otherwise increments in-flight counter.

nodes.name: LoginTokenService.java
nodes.summary: Manages session login tokens stored in Redis with a fixed TTL, providing create, validate (throwing UnauthorizedException), and invalidate operations.

nodes.name: LoginTokenService
nodes.summary: Spring service that creates UUID-based login tokens backed by Redis with 24 h TTL; validates tokens on each authenticated request and supports logout via invalidation.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Looks up the provided token in Redis and throws UnauthorizedException if it is blank or not found.

nodes.name: ModelRateLimiter.java
nodes.summary: Implements per-user token-bucket rate limiting for model inference requests, returning a Decision that indicates whether the request is allowed or must wait with a retry-after duration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a LRU-evicting LinkedHashMap to cap memory usage when many user IDs are seen; inner TokenBucket is synchronized for correctness.

nodes.name: ModelRateLimiter
nodes.summary: Spring service implementing per-user token-bucket rate limiting with configurable RPS/burst, returning a Decision record indicating allowed or throttled with a retry-after duration.

nodes.name: tryAcquire
nodes.summary: Looks up or creates a per-user TokenBucket and attempts to consume one token, returning an unlimited Decision if rate limiting is disabled.

nodes.name: ModelRuntimeProvider.java
nodes.summary: Manages ONNX model runtime instances per A/B variant, pre-warming all configured variants concurrently on Spring startup and providing variant-keyed access to ModelRuntime objects.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements SmartInitializingSingleton to defer warm-up until the full Spring context is ready, avoiding deadlocks; uses ConcurrentHashMap and CompletableFuture for parallel variant loading.

nodes.name: ModelRuntimeProvider
nodes.summary: Spring component that lazily constructs and caches ModelRuntime instances per A/B variant, wiring artifact loading, ONNX inference, candidate selection, and optional Redis embedding store.

nodes.name: warmUp
nodes.summary: Determines the set of required variants from ABTestConfig and pre-loads all of them concurrently using CompletableFuture, blocking until all are ready.

nodes.name: buildRuntime
nodes.summary: Constructs a new ModelRuntime for a given variant: loads model artifacts, initializes the ONNX inference service, and wires a CandidateSelectionService with optional Redis embedding store.

nodes.name: ModelVersionService.java
nodes.summary: Provides model version lifecycle operations — listing loaded variants, preloading on demand, activating a variant as the new default, and rolling back to the previous active variant.

nodes.name: ModelVersionService
nodes.summary: Spring service delegating to ModelRuntimeProvider for runtime lifecycle and ABTestConfig for default variant tracking, supporting zero-downtime model activation and rollback.

nodes.name: activate
nodes.summary: Validates that the requested variant is loaded and ready, then atomically updates the ABTestConfig default variant to activate it.

nodes.name: SubmitTokenService.java
nodes.summary: Implements CSRF-style submit-token protection for the recommendation endpoint: creates single-use tokens stored in Redis with configurable TTL, and atomically validates-and-consumes them via a Lua script.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a Redis Lua eval script for atomic check-and-delete to ensure tokens are consumed exactly once.

nodes.name: SubmitTokenService
nodes.summary: Spring service managing single-use CSRF submit tokens in Redis; createToken() stores UUID with NX+EX, validateAndConsume() atomically removes it via Lua, throwing SubmitTokenException on failure.

nodes.name: createToken
nodes.summary: Generates a UUID token, stores it in Redis with NX+EX params using configured TTL, and returns it; throws SubmitTokenException if feature is disabled or Redis SET fails.

nodes.name: validateAndConsume
nodes.summary: Atomically validates and deletes a submit token from Redis using a Lua script, throwing SubmitTokenException for blank, missing, or already-consumed tokens.

nodes.name: MovieCandidate.java
nodes.summary: Domain record representing a raw candidate movie produced by a recall channel, carrying an item ID, relevance score, source channel name, and feature map.

nodes.name: RankedMovie.java
nodes.summary: Domain record representing a ranked movie result with item ID, score, ordinal rank position, and a feature map populated by the hydrator.

nodes.name: RecommendationQuery.java
nodes.summary: Domain record encapsulating a recommendation request with user ID, requested limit, cursor for pagination, and a set of item IDs to exclude from results.

nodes.name: RecommendationResponse.java
nodes.summary: Minimal domain type representing the HTTP response payload for a recommendation request, used by the serving layer servlet.

nodes.name: RecommendationResult.java
nodes.summary: Domain record wrapping a paginated list of RankedMovie items with a next-page cursor, user ID, and diagnostic metadata map produced by the orchestrator.

nodes.name: FaultInjector.java
nodes.summary: Test/ops utility that injects configurable latency or exceptions at named fault points, used to simulate channel failures in integration and chaos tests.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a ConcurrentHashMap keyed by fault-point name and an inner FaultConfig record with a type discriminator (LATENCY vs EXCEPTION).

nodes.name: FaultInjector
nodes.summary: Manages a registry of fault configurations per named injection point; callers invoke maybeInject before executing a channel to trigger artificial failures.

nodes.name: WorkerBulkhead.java
nodes.summary: Thread-pool bulkhead that isolates recall channel execution, accepting tasks via CompletableFuture submission with a bounded queue and counting rejections for observability.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps ThreadPoolExecutor with an ArrayBlockingQueue and exposes a Snapshot record for metrics; implements AutoCloseable for graceful shutdown.

nodes.name: WorkerBulkhead
nodes.summary: Named fixed-size thread pool with a bounded queue that rejects tasks when full and tracks rejection counts; provides an ExecutorService view and snapshot metrics.

nodes.name: RecommendationHydrator.java
nodes.summary: Functional interface for enriching a list of RankedMovie objects post-ranking; ships an IDENTITY no-op default, allowing downstream enrichment to be plugged in.

nodes.name: CursorPaginationService.java
nodes.summary: Provides cursor-based pagination over an already-ranked list of items by decoding an opaque RankedListCursor offset and slicing the requested window.

nodes.name: Page.java
nodes.summary: Generic domain record holding a page of items and an optional next-cursor string for cursor-based pagination.

nodes.name: CandidateRanker.java
nodes.summary: Functional interface defining the contract for ranking a list of MovieCandidate objects into an ordered list of RankedMovie results given a query and limit.

nodes.name: ScoreRanker.java
nodes.summary: Score-based implementation of CandidateRanker that sorts candidates by descending score (tie-broken by itemId), limits the result, and assigns sequential rank positions.

nodes.name: ScoreRanker
nodes.summary: Stateless ranker that converts MovieCandidate list to RankedMovie list via a sorted stream pipeline with an AtomicInteger rank counter.

nodes.name: RecommendationOrchestrator.java
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full recommendation pipeline: recall, rank, paginate, and hydrate, returning a RecommendationResult with diagnostic metadata.

nodes.name: RecommendationOrchestrator
nodes.summary: Composes MultiChannelRecallService, CandidateRanker, RecommendationHydrator, and CursorPaginationService into a single recommend() call with configurable recall multiplier.

nodes.name: MultiChannelRecallService.java
nodes.summary: Aggregates recall results from multiple RecallChannel implementations in parallel with per-channel timeouts, health-based circuit-breaking, fault injection, and score-max deduplication.

nodes.name: MultiChannelRecallService
nodes.summary: Fans out recall requests across channels using CompletableFuture.supplyAsync, applies per-channel timeout via orTimeout, skips unhealthy channels, merges results by best score, and excludes requested item IDs.

nodes.name: RecallChannel.java
nodes.summary: Interface defining the contract for a recall channel: a named source that returns a list of MovieCandidates given a query and limit.

nodes.name: TrendingChannel.java
nodes.summary: RecallChannel implementation that retrieves trending item IDs from the Redis-backed TrendingStore (last_hour window) and wraps them as MovieCandidates with a fixed relevance score.

nodes.name: TrendingChannel
nodes.summary: Wraps TrendingStore to implement RecallChannel; always queries the last_hour window and assigns a constant SCORE to all returned candidates.

nodes.name: RecommendationService.java
nodes.summary: Jetty HTTP servlet handler for the /getrecommendation endpoint that validates the user, builds a RecommendationQuery from watched history, invokes MultiChannelRecallService, and hydrates results with full Movie objects.

nodes.name: RecommendationService
nodes.summary: Extends a base servlet class to handle GET recommendation requests, excluding watched movies, calling recallService.recall, mapping candidates to Movie objects, and returning a JSON RecommendationResponse.

nodes.name: RecommendationOrchestratorTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit test verifying that RecommendationOrchestrator correctly wires recall, score-ranking, hydration, and cursor pagination across two sequential pages.

nodes.name: MultiChannelRecallServiceTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests covering MultiChannelRecallService behaviors: duplicate merging by best score, exclusion filtering, failing channel isolation, slow channel timeout, and health-monitor back-off gating.

nodes.name: PopularityChannelTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests for PopularityChannel covering top-rated and latest movie combination, deduplication of overlapping results, and channel name correctness.

nodes.name: TrendingChannelTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests for TrendingChannel verifying correct mapping of top-K IDs to MovieCandidates, empty-store handling, and channel name.

nodes.name: WorkerIsolationFailureTest.java
nodes.summary: Integration-style tests verifying WorkerBulkhead and FaultInjector interactions: slow channels do not block fast channels, and a failing channel enters health back-off then recovers after fault removal.

nodes.name: BloomFilterGuard.java
nodes.summary: Thread-safe, lock-free Bloom filter implementation using AtomicLongArray bit-packing to gate cache lookups and avoid spurious Redis fetches for absent embedding IDs.

nodes.name: BloomFilterGuard
nodes.summary: Self-contained probabilistic membership test using configurable false-positive rate and optimal hash-function count, backed by an AtomicLongArray for wait-free concurrent access.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Murmur-style double-hashing (two seeds) composed modulo the bit-array size to spread bits; bit-word updates use AtomicLongArray.updateAndGet for lock-free CAS writes.

nodes.name: HotKeyDetector.java
nodes.summary: Sliding-window access-rate tracker for string and integer keys, used by MultiLevelEmbeddingCache and ShardedTopKStore to identify hot embeddings eligible for L1 promotion.

nodes.name: HotKeyDetector
nodes.summary: Maintains per-key WindowCounter instances (sliding 60-second window by default) in two ConcurrentHashMaps (String and int variants) and exposes isHot, accessRate, and topHotKeys, with an evictIdle method to purge stale entries.
nodes.languageNotes: Inner WindowCounter uses AtomicLong for the current-window count and resets on window boundary; rate is computed as count/elapsed-seconds clamped to the window size.

nodes.name: SingleFlight.java
nodes.summary: Go-style singleflight deduplication primitive that collapses concurrent supplier invocations for the same key into a single execution, with a configurable wait timeout.

nodes.name: SingleFlight
nodes.summary: Uses a ConcurrentHashMap of CompletableFutures keyed by the request key; the first caller creates the future and executes the supplier while subsequent callers wait on it, falling back to direct execution on timeout.
nodes.languageNotes: On InterruptedException the waiting thread restores interrupt status and falls through to directly executing the supplier, ensuring progress guarantees even under thread interruption.

nodes.name: LocalEmbeddingCache.java
nodes.summary: LRU in-process embedding cache wrapping a backing EmbeddingStore, with a BloomFilter to suppress lookups for known-absent IDs, null-sentinel tracking, and SingleFlight to coalesce concurrent cache misses.

nodes.name: LocalEmbeddingCache
nodes.summary: Implements EmbeddingStore using a capacity-bounded LinkedHashMap (synchronized LRU), a BloomFilterGuard for absent-ID gating, a null-sentinel map with TTL to avoid repeated missing-ID fetches, and a SingleFlight for per-ID deduplication of concurrent misses.
nodes.languageNotes: Bloom filter activates only after warmUp/preload populates it; before activation all lookups pass through, ensuring no false negatives during startup.

nodes.name: getEmbeddings
nodes.summary: Batch embedding lookup that separates L1 hits from misses, filters misses through the Bloom filter and null-sentinel map, then bulk-fetches remaining IDs from the backing store and populates the cache.

nodes.name: loadMissingEmbedding
nodes.summary: Singleflight-protected backing-store fetch for a single absent ID; records null sentinel on miss and populates cache on hit.

nodes.name: LogicalExpiryEmbeddingCache.java
nodes.summary: Stale-while-revalidate embedding cache that stores logical expiry timestamps alongside values, returning cached data immediately on soft-TTL expiry while scheduling a background refresh via a thread pool executor.

nodes.name: LogicalExpiryEmbeddingCache
nodes.summary: Implements EmbeddingStore with a ConcurrentHashMap of LogicalEntry records carrying softExpiresAtMs; stale entries trigger a background refresh via an Executor while returning the old value, and cold misses are deduplicated via SingleFlight.

nodes.name: MultiLevelEmbeddingCache.java
nodes.summary: Three-tier (L1 heap ConcurrentHashMap, L2 LogicalExpiryEmbeddingCache, L3 EmbeddingStore) embedding cache with hot-key-aware L1 promotion, null-sentinel fast-path, and per-tier hit counters exposed via TierStats.

nodes.name: MultiLevelEmbeddingCache
nodes.summary: Cascades lookups through L1 (bounded ConcurrentHashMap), L2, then L3 with graceful tier degradation on exceptions; uses HotKeyDetector to decide L1 promotion, tracks per-tier AtomicLong hit counters, and includes an inner Builder and TierStats record.
nodes.languageNotes: L1 is a plain ConcurrentHashMap with capacity enforced by evicting an arbitrary key on overflow — HotKeyDetector gates whether a newly fetched item is worth occupying a slot.

nodes.name: getEmbedding
nodes.summary: Single-key three-tier lookup with null-sentinel short-circuit, L1/L2/L3 fallback chain, graceful exception handling at each tier, and L1 promotion for qualifying items.

nodes.name: getEmbeddings
nodes.summary: Batch three-tier lookup that partitions IDs across tiers, propagates hot-key recording for L1 hits, and consolidates fetched vectors into the result map with null-sentinel recording for full misses.

nodes.name: RedisEmbeddingStore.java
nodes.summary: Redis-backed EmbeddingStore that serializes float-array embeddings as space-separated strings, supports pipelined batch writes and MGET-batched reads, and adds jittered TTL to prevent thundering-herd expiry.

nodes.name: RedisEmbeddingStore
nodes.summary: Implements EmbeddingStore using a JedisPool; individual and batch reads use MGET chunked by configurable batch size; bulk writes use Jedis pipelines; loadAll performs a full SCAN to warm caches at startup.
nodes.languageNotes: TTL jitter is applied per-write as a random fraction (default ±10%) of the base TTL in milliseconds, using ThreadLocalRandom; this spreads cache-expiry storms under high write volume.

nodes.name: loadAll
nodes.summary: Full Redis SCAN loop that reads all keys matching the embedding key-prefix, retrieves their values via MGET per page, and deserializes each into a float[] embedding map for cache warm-up.

nodes.name: scanIds
nodes.summary: Iterates Redis SCAN pages to collect up to maxKeys integer IDs from keys matching the store's prefix, used to seed bloom filters and local caches.

nodes.name: EmbeddingStore.java
nodes.summary: Core interface defining the embedding storage contract: single and batch get/set by integer ID, scanIds for key enumeration, and TTL-aware writes; implemented by Redis, local cache, and multi-level cache variants.

nodes.name: EmbeddingStore
nodes.summary: Interface with five methods: getEmbedding(int), getEmbeddings(Collection), setEmbedding(int, float[], long), setEmbeddings(Map, long), scanIds(int).

nodes.name: VectorMath.java
nodes.summary: Static utility class providing cosine similarity, inner product, squared-norm computation, and string-to-float-array parsing for embedding vectors used across the serving and model-based paths.

nodes.name: cosine
nodes.summary: Computes cosine similarity between two float vectors as innerProduct(a,b) / sqrt(normSq(a) * normSq(b)).

nodes.name: parseVector
nodes.summary: Parses a whitespace-delimited string of floats into a float[], validating each component is finite and rejecting blank input.

nodes.name: ModelArtifactService.java
nodes.summary: Loads ONNX model artifacts (feature config, user/item vocab, item embeddings) from a locator path or Redis for a given model variant, providing immutable accessors used by RetrievalService and RankingService.

nodes.name: ModelArtifactService

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: The README is the single best orientation to this multi-service recommendation system. It names the four independently runnable services (ports 6010, 7010, 8080, 8010) and establishes the three parallel recommendation paths — offline/batch Word2Vec, online real-time Redis signals, and model-based two-tower ONNX — that the rest of the tour traces through code. Read it first to internalize the vocabulary: recall, ranking, candidate generation, and A/B testing, all of which reappear as concrete Java classes in later steps.

tour.title: Shared Domain Model
tour.description: Before any service can run, the shared domain objects must be understood: Movie, User, MovieCandidate, and RecommendationQuery are referenced by 22, 11, 17, and 18 other files respectively — the highest fan-in scores in the graph. These Java records form the common data contract across all four services. MovieCandidate carries the recall channel name and feature map alongside a relevance score, making it the key hand-off object between retrieval and ranking. RecommendationQuery encapsulates pagination cursor and exclusion sets, enabling the cursor-based result-set pattern used throughout.
tour.languageLesson: Java records (introduced in Java 16) are immutable, shallow-equal data carriers with auto-generated constructors, getters, equals, hashCode, and toString. They replace verbose POJOs and are ideal for domain value objects that should never change after construction.

tour.title: Embedding Store Abstraction
tour.description: EmbeddingStore is the core interface that decouples the vector layer from its backing store — it defines get/set, batch MGET, scanIds, and TTL-aware writes. With 11 fan-in references it is the most-used infrastructure contract in the system. RedisEmbeddingStore is the primary production implementation, serializing float arrays as space-separated strings and using Redis pipelines for batch writes. The three-tier MultiLevelEmbeddingCache wraps it with an L1 heap ConcurrentHashMap and L2 logical-expiry cache to avoid repeated Redis round trips for hot items.
tour.languageLesson: The interface-plus-multi-level-cache pattern is a classic infrastructure layering technique: define a pure interface (EmbeddingStore), then wrap it in caching decorators (L1→L2→L3) without changing the contract. Each layer implements the same interface and delegates on miss, making the chain transparent to callers.

tour.title: Offline Path: Catalog Serving Entry Point
tour.description: RecSysServer is the Jetty entry point for the offline recommendation path (port 6010) and has the highest fan-out of any non-test Java file — it wires 15 collaborators at startup. It initializes Redis connections, the DataManager singleton (which eagerly loads all movie/user/rating artifacts from classpath text files), the RedisEmbeddingStore, and the CandidateGenerator. The server exposes /getrecommendation, /similar, /setembedding, and the v1 predict endpoint — all backed by pre-computed Word2Vec embeddings already stored in Redis. DataManager is the second most-imported class in the codebase (16 fan-in) and is the authoritative source of in-memory movie/user data.

tour.title: Candidate Generation & Vector Search
tour.description: CandidateGenerator (11 fan-in) is the retrieval core of the offline path. It offers three strategies: genre-based filtering, user-history expansion, and embedding nearest-neighbor search via an in-memory ANN index over Redis-stored vectors. VectorMath provides the cosine-similarity and inner-product primitives that power the ANN search. CandidateGenerator's results flow into the RecommendationOrchestrator in Step 8, which ranks, paginates, and hydrates them into the final API response. Understanding this class clarifies why the Redis key convention uses i2vEmb:<id> and u2vEmb:<id> — those are the keys CandidateGenerator scans when it builds its nearest-neighbor index.

tour.title: Multi-Channel Recall Service
tour.description: MultiChannelRecallService is the retrieval orchestrator used by the recommendation-service layer. It fans out recall in parallel across four pluggable RecallChannel implementations: EmbeddingChannel (vector ANN), GenreHistoryChannel (content-based), PopularityChannel (static popularity), and TrendingChannel (live Redis Top-K). Each channel runs with a per-channel timeout and a circuit-breaker that health-checks before dispatching. A FaultInjector injects artificial latency or errors for chaos testing. This design isolates failures per channel and degrades gracefully — if the embedding channel is slow, popularity results still return on time.
tour.languageLesson: The RecallChannel interface is a strategy pattern: each channel is independently testable, replaceable, and health-monitored. Parallelism via CompletableFuture with per-channel timeouts ensures one slow source cannot block the entire recall phase.

tour.title: Online Path: Real-Time Prediction Server
tour.description: OnlinePredictionServer is the Jetty entry point for the online path (port 7010) with the highest fan-out in the entire codebase (22 edges). It wires Redis connection pools, the OnlineFeatureStore (two-level stale-while-revalidate cache backed by Redis), ShardedTopKStore for windowed trending items (last_hour/last_day/last_month), the OnlineLearner for lightweight logistic-loss parameter updates from user events, and the full admission-control stack. OnlineFeaturesService is the Armeria HTTP handler that applies load shedding and rate limiting before dispatching to the recommendation engine — no neural model is involved here, only live Redis signals.

tour.title: Model Path: Spring Boot ONNX Service
tour.description: ModelApplication (port 8080) is the Spring Boot entry point for the model-based path. The request lifecycle begins at RecommendationController, which enforces rate limiting, A/B variant assignment, and submit-token CSRF protection, then delegates to RecommendationService. RecommendationService checks the cache, handles cold-start via feature flags, and on a cache miss invokes RetrievalService (user-tower ONNX encoding + metadata filtering) followed by RankingService (inner-product scoring of item embeddings). ScoredItem is the DTO that flows between retrieval and ranking, carrying an item ID and scalar score.
tour.languageLesson: Spring Boot uses @ConfigurationProperties to bind YAML sections to typed POJOs at startup (see application.yml recsys.ab-test.* and recsys.cache.*). This eliminates stringly-typed environment variable lookups and gives compile-time visibility into configuration options.

tour.title: Recommendation Orchestrator
tour.description: RecommendationOrchestrator is the shared pipeline glue (14 fan-out) used by both the model-based and catalog-serving paths. It sequences the four phases — recall via MultiChannelRecallService, score/rank, paginate with the cursor helper, and hydrate MovieCandidate objects into full Movie records — and returns a RecommendationResult with timing and diagnostic metadata. The orchestrator is the best single file to read for a precise mental model of how a recommendation request flows from query to response across all recall channels.

tour.title: Feature Flags & A/B Testing
tour.description: The feature-flag system controls behavioral switches throughout all four services. Flags.java declares named flags like COLD_START_ENABLED and NEW_RANKING as FeatureFlag constants (13 fan-in). FeatureFlagService wraps a pluggable FeatureFlagProvider (8 fan-in) with convenience isEnabled() overloads. The provider chain is assembled in FeatureFlagConfig: an EnvFeatureFlagProvider handles environment-variable-driven flags, optionally wrapped by a PostHog provider and a CachingFeatureFlagProvider. This design allows RecommendationService to switch ranking algorithms or enable cold-start fallback at runtime without redeployment.

tour.title: Online Admission Control
tour.description: The online serving path has a layered admission-control stack that prevents cascade failures under traffic spikes. RedisRateLimiter (9 fan-in) implements a Lua-script-based sliding-window rate limiter with a local pass-through fraction and a circuit-breaker fallback when Redis is unavailable. OnlineLoadShedder uses a semaphore to cap concurrent in-flight requests and exposes utilization metrics plus retry-after guidance for overloaded clients. Together these two components protect the OnlinePredictionServer from overwhelming its Redis backend while still providing graceful degradation rather than hard failures.
tour.languageLesson: Redis Lua scripts execute atomically on the Redis server, making them ideal for rate-limit counters that require compare-and-set semantics without a client-side round trip. The script increments a key, sets TTL on first write, and returns the current count — all in one network call.

tour.title: API Gateway
tour.description: MicroserviceGatewayServer (port 8010) is the single entry point for external clients. It routes to all three backend services and the optional LLM explanation endpoint. GatewayRateLimiter applies per-route token-bucket limiting configurable from environment variables. RouteCircuitBreaker implements the half-open probe pattern, opening after N consecutive failures and letting through probe requests to detect recovery. LlmProxyService adds token-budget tracking, response caching, and streaming support for the LLM route. This gateway is also responsible for 30-second Cloud Map DNS TTL management during EKS blue/green deployments.

tour.title: Streaming Infrastructure
tour.description: docker-compose.streaming.yml orchestrates the full real-time pipeline: Zookeeper + Kafka for the event bus, a Redis primary-replica-sentinel cluster for high-availability feature storage, and Apache Flink (jobmanager + taskmanager) for stream processing. The Flink OnlineFeatureStreamingJob (in streaming/flink/, excluded from Maven compile) consumes Kafka events and writes per-user feature vectors and windowed Top-K trending data back into Redis under the keys that OnlinePredictionServer reads. This compose file is how you spin up the complete online path locally.
tour.languageLesson: Docker Compose sentinel configurations use three sentinel containers (redis-sentinel-1/2/3) that vote on which Redis replica to promote on primary failure. A majority quorum (2 of 3) is required for failover, making this topology resilient to a single sentinel node crash.

tour.title: Containerization & Build
tour.description: The Dockerfile uses a two-stage build: the builder stage runs Maven on Amazon Corretto 17 to compile and package the JAR, then the runtime stage copies only the built artifact into a minimal Corretto 17 JRE image. This keeps the production image lean by excluding the Maven cache and source files. The application.yml (Spring Boot model-serving config) shows the full configuration surface: server port, graceful shutdown settings, Redis connection (standalone or sentinel mode), ONNX model artifact path, A/B test variant weights, cache TTLs, and submit-token settings.
tour.languageLesson: Multi-stage Docker builds use multiple FROM instructions. The first stage has build tools (Maven, JDK) and produces the artifact; the second stage starts from a clean base image and COPYs only what is needed at runtime. Docker discards the intermediate layers, so the final image contains no build toolchain.

tour.title: Kubernetes Deployment
tour.description: The k8s/base/ directory contains Kustomize manifests for all four services. configmap.yaml defines the shared recsys-config ConfigMap injected into every pod, setting Redis connection details, inter-service URLs, rate-limit thresholds, and circuit-breaker parameters. kustomization.yaml aggregates all base manifests. The k8s/eks/ overlay adds EKS-specific patches: IRSA annotations for the gateway's AWS IAM role, Cloud Map service entries for blue/green DNS routing, an ElastiCache patch for Redis, and image-pull-policy overrides. Together these manifests describe the full production topology that mirrors the four-service architecture introduced in Step 1.
tour.languageLesson: Kustomize uses a base-plus-overlay model: k8s/base/ holds environment-agnostic manifests, and k8s/eks/ holds patches that are merged on top for EKS production. Running `kubectl apply -k k8s/eks/` applies both in one step, keeping environment differences explicit and auditable.
